description: This header file defines the class dm_op_class_list_t, which manages a list of operation classes in a mesh network configuration context. It includes methods for initialization, database sync and update, configuration management, and iteration over operation classes.

classes.name: dm_op_class_list_t
classes.description: A class that manages a list of operation classes, providing methods for initialization, configuration, database synchronization, iteration, and retrieval of operation classes.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the operation class list, setting up necessary structures and resources.

methods.name: get_dm_orch_type
methods.description: Determines the DM orchestration type based on database client and operation class.

methods.name: update_list
methods.description: Updates the list with a specified operation class and orchestration type.

methods.name: delete_list
methods.description: Deletes the list and frees associated resources.

methods.name: init_table
methods.description: Initializes the associated table data structures.

methods.name: init_columns
methods.description: Initializes table columns for the operation class list.

methods.name: sync_db
methods.description: Synchronizes the database with the current state based on the provided context.

methods.name: update_db
methods.description: Performs an update on the database with specific operation type and data.

methods.name: search_db
methods.description: Searches the database for an entry matching the provided key.

methods.name: set_config
methods.description: Sets configuration in the database client using a JSON object.

methods.name: get_config
methods.description: Retrieves configuration settings into a JSON object, optionally providing a summary.

methods.name: get_first_op_class
methods.description: Returns the first operation class; pure virtual, must be implemented by derived classes.

methods.name: get_next_op_class
methods.description: Returns the next operation class after the provided one; pure virtual.

methods.name: get_op_class
methods.description: Retrieves an operation class by its key; pure virtual.

methods.name: remove_op_class
methods.description: Removes an operation class matching the given key; pure virtual.

methods.name: put_op_class
methods.description: Associates an operation class with a key; pure virtual.

methods.name: get_first_pre_set_op_class_by_type
methods.description: Returns the first operation class of a specified type; pure virtual.

methods.name: get_next_pre_set_op_class_by_type
methods.description: Returns the next operation class of a specific type starting from a given class; pure virtual.
